svg.text: Architecture 2 - Decomposition of the three CONTROL subsystems
Lowest-level responsibility view: composition creates an executable snapshot, orchestration advances it deterministically, and governance constrains the decision and report.
select only providers/models used by this run
bind node configs, failure policy, retry, budget
known node types; typed ports; reachability
declared loops; join/fan-in; side effects; budgets
all non-loop parents must be terminal-acceptable
stable node-ID sort prevents race-dependent order
gather typed tasks; aggregate inputs by port
save node states, outputs, sequence, consumed IDs
pause only between waves; cancel cooperatively
optional stale branches may degrade when allowed
deterministic draft defines facts and shape
model edits narrative; protected fields stay owned
declared loop count prevents unbounded agents
agent views + evidence refs + settings + warning
JSON/PDF, hash, disclaimer; never execute trades
